title: Clearwater Forest the Next Generation Intel® Xeon® Processor with Efficiency Cores
problem: Multi-core Xeon processors need improved power efficiency and performance balance across diverse workloads.
motivation: Data center workloads require efficiency cores to balance performance and energy consumption in large-scale deployments.
method: Intel's Clearwater Forest design integrates efficiency cores alongside performance cores, enabling flexible power management and task scheduling across heterogeneous execution units.
key_novelty: Integration of efficiency cores in Xeon processors to improve energy efficiency and power scaling.
contributions: Heterogeneous core architecture combining P-cores and E-cores in Xeon
Improved power efficiency for data center workloads
